game.title: Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order
game.blurb: Action-adventure from Respawn Entertainment, released 2019-11-15. RAWG average playtime: 8 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Cal's journey aboard the Mantis in search of the holocron. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Exploration and Secrets
chapters.summary: Chests, secrets, BD-1's holomaps, stim canisters, encrypted logs, Force Echoes, the terrarium and mysterious creatures.

chapters.title: Combat and the Force
chapters.summary: Parries, reflected bolts, kicks, lightsaber throws, Slow, explosives and enemy scans.

chapters.title: Skills, Crew and Customizing
chapters.summary: Jedi skills, the Mantis crew, and customizing the lightsaber, Cal, BD-1 and the ship.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1172380)
StrategyWiki: stub page only, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Star_Wars_Jedi:_Fallen_Order
Fandom (starwars.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Star_Wars_Jedi:_Fallen_Order
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a page (no completion stage in its page data); the Walkthrough is linked but not written, and only Achievements and trophies, Enemies and Table of Contents subpages exist, so no structure was taken. starwars.fandom.com (Wookieepedia) answers the API; its page hit the 500-link limit of the query; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 14 of 39 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the main story chapter. Three hidden ones have low unlock rates ("Visiting Alderaan Places" 13%, "Blade Master" 28%, "Scum and Villainy" 31%) and may be optional rather than story; check them. "Kicking Back" (phillak) and "Cal Got Your Tongue?" (oggdo) were left in combat.
